changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 2a, item 12 (R47): `dreamux serve` no longer runs its startup pre-flight that aggregated every dispatcher's pre-#233 leftover state and removed cron stores and aborted the whole process before the admin socket opened, and `dreamux doctor` no longer reports a dispatcher's leftover state as a row. A stale `channel-bindings.json`/`collaboration-spaces.json` at the dispatcher root, a pre-#233 flat `teammate/`/`team/` leaf (`records`, `turns`, `identities`, `history`, `sessions.jsonl`, `ledger`), or an agent identity record still carrying a removed field (`checkpoint`, `checkpoint_kind`, `session_ref`, `display_name`, `close_status`) are now silently ignored rather than triggering a fail-loud rebuild instruction. This is not `BREAKING:`: nothing an operator relied on to start stops working — the opposite failure mode (refusing to start) is what's removed. A cron store with an unrecognized version and an identity still keyed by the pre-#148 `provider_ref` format still raise a named error when actually read (a dispatcher's scheduler start, `dreamux doctor`'s unchanged cron rows), but that failure is no longer aggregated into a whole-process startup refusal — it now fails only the one dispatcher whose store or identity is affected, the same as any other per-dispatcher start failure.
